gang_run_printing_tooltip.title: Gang run printing
gang_run_printing_tooltip.intro: Gang run printing is a process where artwork from multiple clients is combined onto a single printing plate and printed using the same paper type.
pros: Low Cost: Plate-making and printing costs are shared among multiple clients.
Ideal for Small Batches: Perfect for clients with smaller print orders, with a minimum order quantity (MOQ) starting at 200 copies per design.
cons: Low Flexibility: Color variations during printing and MOQs are subject to standard limitations.
Color Differences Between Batches: Color variations may occur across different print runs, and overall color accuracy is relatively lower compared to custom runs.

faq.question: How do I order business cards?
faq.answer: Pick a paper, choose a size, then either use a template, upload artwork, or design from scratch in the browser. Add to cart and we ship within 3–5 working days.

faq.question: Which InkPavo paper is best for my business?
faq.answer: Original is our most popular all-rounder. Super suits agencies that want a thicker hand-feel; Luxe and Cotton are for premium first impressions.

faq.question: How do I find a good design for my cards?
faq.answer: Browse 1000s of free templates in our design tool, or start from scratch with our preset layouts and brand colour picker.

faq.question: Which side should I print on?
faq.answer: Both. Front for your name, role, and primary contact details; back for your tagline, social handles, or QR code.

faq.question: Which file formats are best?
faq.answer: PDF (300 DPI, CMYK) gives the sharpest result. PNG and JPG at 300 DPI also work — just make sure colours are CMYK, not RGB.

faq.question: What is SF Express and other shipping options?
faq.answer: SF Express is our default carrier for fast worldwide delivery. DHL and USPS are available at checkout depending on destination.

about_page.title: About InkPavo
body_paragraphs: Since rooting ourselves in Shanghai, China in 2003, we have stood as pioneers in the Chinese printing industry. Over the past 23 years, we have deepened our industry insight and amassed profound technical expertise. With over 20 years of offline and 15 years of online printing experience, we precisely understand the core needs of every client—from individual consumers and corporate partners to advertising agencies and creative designers—delivering highly tailored solutions for each group.

Today, we are bringing this long-standing heritage of professional service, exquisite craftsmanship, and flexible customization to the global stage. Through InkPavo, we are dedicated to making premium-quality printing services accessible to clients worldwide. Our vision is to redefine the industry benchmark for online printing by delivering superior quality at highly competitive prices.

sections.heading: Our Vision & Global Capabilities
sections.body: In response to the global wave of small-batch, highly diverse customization, InkPavo has reconstructed the entire supply chain—from design and production to logistics. Leveraging our specialized production facilities across China, we deliver highly diverse printing solutions. On our continuous path of growth, we remain steadfastly focused on two core pillars: transforming your creative designs into physical products that achieve the ultimate balance of exquisite quality and exceptional cost-effectiveness. This is the fundamental difference that sets InkPavo apart from ordinary printing providers. As a fast-growing industry leader, we continue to explore cutting-edge technologies, driving the innovation and upgrading of printing services with a truly global vision.

privacy_page.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how InkPavo ("we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, shares, and protects information about you when you visit our website or use our services. This is sample copy provided for layout purposes and should be replaced with a privacy policy tailored to your business and reviewed by your legal counsel before you go live.

sections.heading: 1. Information we collect
sections.body: We collect three broad categories of information:

list_items.text: Account details, billing and shipping addresses, artwork you upload, and any messages you send to our support team.
Usage data such as pages visited, device and browser type, IP address, and cookies that help us recognise you across visits.
Payment confirmation from our payment processors and shipping events from carriers.

sections.heading: 2. How we use your information
list_items: To process orders, fulfil them, and keep you updated on their progress.
To provide customer support and respond to your enquiries.
To improve our products, services, and the way our website works.
To send marketing communications where you've opted in. You can unsubscribe at any time using the link in any email.
To comply with legal obligations and protect against fraud or misuse.

sections.heading: 3. Sharing your information
sections.body: We share data only with parties who help us operate the business — payment processors, fulfilment partners, shipping carriers, and the analytics tools we use to understand how the site is performing. We never sell your personal information.

sections.heading: 4. Cookies
sections.body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device. We use them to keep you signed in, remember items in your cart, and measure how visitors use the site. You can disable non-essential cookies at any time through your browser settings or our cookie preferences panel.

sections.heading: 5. Your rights
sections.body: Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, or delete the personal information we hold about you, to object to certain processing, or to receive your data in a portable format. To exercise any of these rights, email privacy@inkpavo.com.

sections.heading: 6. Data retention
sections.body: We keep personal information only as long as necessary to provide our services, comply with legal obligations, and resolve disputes. Order records are typically kept for seven years to satisfy tax and accounting requirements.

sections.heading: 7. Security
sections.body: We use industry-standard administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect your information. No system is perfect, however, and we encourage you to use a strong, unique password and to keep your account credentials confidential.

sections.heading: 8. Children's privacy
sections.body: Our services are not directed to children under 16, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, contact us and we'll delete it.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The most current version will always be posted on this page; we'll let you know about significant changes by email or through a notice on the site.

sections.heading: 10. Contact
sections.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Email privacy@inkpavo.com or visit our contact page.

By using our services you confirm that you are at least 18 years old, or that you have the consent of a parent or legal guardian, and that you have the authority to enter into a binding contract.

sections.heading: 2. Your account
sections.body: You are responsible for keeping your account credentials confidential and for all activity that takes place under your account. Notify us immediately if you suspect unauthorized use. We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms.

sections.heading: 3. Orders and payment
sections.body: All orders are subject to acceptance and product availability. Prices shown on the site are inclusive of applicable taxes unless otherwise stated. Payment is taken at the point of order, and a confirmation email is sent once your order has been received. We reserve the right to cancel any order at our discretion, including for reasons of pricing errors or suspected fraud.

sections.heading: 4. Intellectual property and your artwork
sections.body: You retain ownership of any artwork or content you upload to InkPavo. By uploading content, you confirm that you have the right to reproduce it and grant us a limited licence to print, fulfil, and ship your order. You agree not to upload content that infringes the rights of a third party or that is unlawful, defamatory, or obscene.

sections.heading: 5. Delivery
sections.body: Estimated delivery times are provided at checkout and are indicative only. We are not responsible for delays caused by carriers, customs, or events outside our reasonable control. Risk in the products passes to you on delivery.

sections.heading: 6. Returns and refunds
sections.body: Because each order is printed to your specification, products are generally non-returnable. If your order arrives damaged, defective, or materially different from what you ordered, contact us within 14 days of delivery and we'll arrange a reprint or refund.

sections.heading: 7. Limitation of liability
sections.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, InkPavo is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential losses arising from your use of our services. Our total liability for any claim relating to an order is limited to the amount you paid for that order.

sections.heading: 8. Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these Terms from time to time. The most current version will always be posted on this page; substantial changes will be highlighted at the top of the page. Continued use of the service after changes are posted constitutes acceptance.

sections.heading: 9. Contact
sections.body: Questions about these Terms? Email legal@inkpavo.com or visit our contact page.

faq.question: What postcard sizes do you offer?
faq.answer: Standard 4×6, square ~4.72", medium 5×7, large 6×9, and rack cards. Custom sizes may be available on request.

faq.question: What is the minimum order quantity?
faq.answer: Most postcard products start at 50–100 pieces depending on size and stock. Exact MOQs are shown on each product page.

faq.question: Which file formats do you accept?
faq.answer: Print-ready PDF is preferred (with bleed). We also accept AI, EPS, and SVG for design service. High-resolution PNG/JPG may work for simpler jobs after review.

faq.question: How long does production take?
faq.answer: Typical production is a few business days after proof approval, plus shipping. Rush options may be available — ask when you order.

faq.question: Can you design my postcard for me?
faq.answer: Yes. Use our design service for free typesetting (print customers), $5 template layout, or $10 custom original design.

faq.question: Do you offer custom die-cut shapes?
faq.answer: Yes. Die-cut stickers can follow your artwork outline. Provide a clear vector path when possible for the best cut.

faq.question: What's the difference between paper and vinyl?
faq.answer: Matte paper is great for packaging and short-term indoor use. Vinyl is more durable for moisture, outdoor, or high-touch applications.

faq.question: What file formats work best?
faq.answer: Vector (AI, EPS, PDF, SVG) is ideal for sharp edges and die-cuts. High-resolution PNG with transparent background also works for many designs.

faq.question: Is there a minimum order?
faq.answer: Minimums vary by shape and material — typically from small starter packs up to bulk runs. See product pages for current MOQs.

faq.question: Can you design stickers for my brand?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Use our design service for template layout ($5) or custom original design ($10), or upload finished files for free prep when printing with us.

faq.question: What flyer and brochure sizes do you offer?
faq.answer: US Letter, half-page, long, and square flyers, plus tri-fold and bi-fold brochures. Product pages list exact dimensions and paper options.

faq.question: Do you have ready-to-order flyer packs?
faq.answer: Yes — for example Flyer Printing (1000 pack) and Tri-Fold Brochure Printing (500 pack). More formats are listed under shop filters as inventory expands.

faq.question: What file setup do you need?
faq.answer: Print-ready PDF with 0.125" bleed and critical content inside safe margins. For folds, keep important elements away from fold lines.

faq.question: Can you design multi-panel brochures?
faq.answer: Yes. Template layout and custom design paths cover multi-panel work — start from our design service page and describe your panels and goals.

faq.question: How fast can I get flyers?
faq.answer: Production typically takes several business days after proof approval, plus shipping. Ask about rush if you have a hard event date.
